title: The Graduation Cakes
story: June means graduations, and in Thimble Harbor graduations mean cake from the Salt & Sugar Bakery. Rosa took four cake orders while feeding Gloria, her sourdough starter, and wrote down every flavor and every topper but not a single customer's name. Pickup starts at noon. Which customer ordered which flavor, and which topper goes on each cake?

texts: The carrot cake's buyer chose neither the mortarboard nor the owl topper.
Of the carrot cake's buyer and the coconut cake's buyer, one is Elsa and the other is Gus.
Jade ordered either the lemon or the carrot cake.
The customer who chose the star ordered either the chocolate or the lemon cake.
The customer who chose the mortarboard is neither Tariq nor Gus.
Tariq chose either the owl or the diploma topper.

trace.text: Clue 3 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Clue 4 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
The carrot cake must go with the diploma topper: clue 1 rules out the mortarboard topper and the owl topper; clue 4 rules out the star topper.
Clue 6 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Clue 2 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Jade must go with the lemon cake: clue 2 rules out the carrot cake; clue 3 rules out the chocolate cake and the coconut cake.
Tariq must go with the chocolate cake: clue 2 rules out the carrot cake and the coconut cake; the lemon cake already goes with Jade.
Tariq must go with the owl topper: clue 5 rules out the mortarboard topper; clue 6 rules out the star topper; the diploma topper is already ruled out for the carrot cake.
The chocolate cake goes with Tariq, so the chocolate cake also goes with the owl topper.
The coconut cake must go with the mortarboard topper: clue 4 rules out the star topper; the other choices are already taken.
The lemon cake must go with the star topper: the owl topper is already ruled out for Jade; the other choices are already taken.
Jade must go with the star topper: the mortarboard topper is already ruled out for the lemon cake; the diploma topper is already ruled out for the carrot cake; the owl topper already goes with Tariq.
Gus must go with the diploma topper: clue 5 rules out the mortarboard topper; the other choices are already taken.
Elsa must go with the mortarboard topper: the other choices are already taken.
The carrot cake goes with the diploma topper, so the carrot cake also goes with Gus.
Elsa must go with the coconut cake: clue 2 rules out the lemon cake and the chocolate cake; the carrot cake already goes with Gus.
